The dish looks like a small white bowl holding sliced almonds. The wooden board it sits on is about 15 cm wide, and the bowl takes up most of that width, so the bowl is roughly 11-12 cm across.

The bowl looks fairly full, so I'd guess about 1 cup of sliced almonds. That weighs roughly 90 g, though the fill level is uncertain, so the true amount could be nearer 60-100 g. I'll use 70 g.

Sliced almonds are about 575-600 kcal per 100 g, so 70 g comes to roughly 410 kcal.
